content.short: SharkTeam provides smart contract audits, chain analytics, and emergency response services.
content.description: SharkTeam delivers comprehensive Web3 security services, specializing in smart contract audits, chain analytics, and rapid emergency response. Its mission is to safeguard the Web3 ecosystem by identifying vulnerabilities, monitoring activity, and coordinating timely remediation to reduce risk across networks. The team comprises seasoned security professionals and senior researchers from around the world, with deep expertise in the underlying theory of blockchain technology and smart contracts and a proven track record of applying that knowledge to real-world challenges.
content.meta: SharkTeam is a Web3 security provider offering audits, analytics, and emergency response. Discover SharkTeam and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
